title: Meet the new Shelfie
text: Two new touches just landed in Shelfie. Books can have real cover pictures, and a review assistant helps the grown up give kind, useful feedback.

title: Add a book with a picture
text: Nia adds The Hobbit. She types the title, picks a colour and a sticker, then chooses a picture. The preview shows her cover straight away.

title: On the shelf
text: The book goes on her shelf with its picture, right next to the others.

title: Change or remove a cover
text: A grown up can change a cover any time from Manage book. The new picture appears as soon as it uploads.

title: Help me review
text: Over in Review, Dad opens a chapter and presses Help me review. The assistant flags short answers that deserve a conversation, with a reason for each.

title: A kind note, ready to edit
text: It also drafts an encouraging note. Dad can use it as it is, or make it his own, pick a sticker, and send it to Nia.

title: Always in the parent's hands
text: Nothing is sent until Dad says so, and if the assistant is ever unavailable, reviewing works just as before.
